summary: Strata at Mission Bay is a roughly 192-193 unit apartment building at 555 Mission Rock St; DBI records its construction permit complete on 2009-07-15 and DataSF Assessor records give 2009 as the building's year built; SocketSite reported in January 2009 that its units were expected to come online that March.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200607247440 filed to erect an 8-story, 192-dwelling-unit building with storage/parking/retail at 555 Mission Rock St

DBI recorded the construction permit (8 stories, 192 dwelling units) complete on 2009-07-15, and the Assessor gives 2009 as the year built. SocketSite had forecast in January 2009 that the rental units would come online that March and reported in February 2009 that move-ins were scheduled for March 1 with 'a long way to go'; no source read confirms when tenants moved in.

costs.what: SF Department of Building Inspection permit #200607247440's construction-cost valuation (estimated and revised cost both $12,000,000) for the 8-story, 192-unit building at 555 Mission Rock St

images.appeal_note: A straight-down orthophoto rather than an oblique aerial, but Oracle Park and Chase Center are both clearly recognizable landmarks in the frame, giving anyone who knows the city an immediate fix on the neighborhood.

images.appeal_note: Oracle Park's diamond and Chase Center's dome (with its own logo) are both clearly identifiable landmarks in one colorful frame -- reads far better at card size than the flatter government orthophoto.

open_questions: DataSF Assessor lists 193 units for this parcel versus the 192 reported by SocketSite and repeated across apartment-listing sites; the one-unit gap (possibly a manager's unit or a later modification) is not resolved.
Exact first move-in date (SocketSite's comments mention 'March 1st' from a commenter, not the article itself) is not confirmed from a primary source.
Developer/architect not confirmed from any source checked as of 2026-09-21.
No opening date found for Insomnia Cookies (1215 4th St): checked its own Yelp listing and site for a firm date; Pier & Point's retail table also lists no opening date.
No opening date found for One Medical (1285 4th St): checked its own location page for a firm date; Pier & Point's retail table also lists no opening date.
No opening date found for The UPS Store #6609 (1225 4th St): checked its own location page for a firm date; Pier & Point's retail table also lists no opening date.

Teappo was removed from the retail table: shopteappo.com is an online Shopify store with no address or storefront. 1225 4th St is The UPS Store #6609's address, and DataSF business registrations there use unit/PMB numbers, so 'Unit 616' is not evidence of a storefront.

Insomnia Cookies (1215 4th St) has not been re-confirmed as open: its Yelp listing could not be checked. A DataSF business registration exists at that address from 2022-02-16 with no end date, but a registration is not evidence of an operating storefront; Insomnia Cookies' own store locator has not yet been checked.
